# SDL GameControllerDB mapping

Source: https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB

Exact revision: `c1d5289a1f713b30a2c121e9fe6529d39360be0f`.

Retained one Windows 8BitDo SN30 Pro mapping (VID 2DC8, PID 6101)
verbatim from gamecontrollerdb.txt. No mapping adaptations; sn30_pro_windows.h wraps that line in a C string. Registered before
launcher and gameplay enumeration to supplement the pinned SDL2 database.
License: zlib, reproduced in LICENSE.txt. No game assets are included.

LICENSE.txt retains the upstream license wording with trailing whitespace normalized.
